description: App launcher tile style: full-colour brand-feel app icon designed to sit on a Home Screen rounded-square tile. Distinct from in-app symbols/glyphs. Hardened against feature-glyph leakage when variant purposes are feature-named. Only `watch` and `notification` variants opt out of the purpose_wrapper (via empty-string overrides) because their state_requirements demand a 1-bit silhouette — a fundamentally different render than the launcher-tile wrapper assumes. All other variant IDs (main, share-ext, light, dark, icon, alternate-N, etc.) receive the default launcher-tile wrapper; light and dark also pick up state_requirements with surface-tinted hints.

prompt_blocks.house_style: App launcher tile style: a complete branded application icon meant to sit on the device Home Screen as a rounded-square tile users tap to open the app. Full-colour palette (no forced monochrome), bold simple iconic shape that fills the canvas and reads as a unified product mark, square-friendly composition, distinctive brand personality. The icon must read at thumbnail size (16x16) and stay strong at 1024x1024. Solid filled shapes with a confident colour palette; subtle one-step shading is fine; flat is fine. Avoid photorealism, gradients heavier than one stop, soft drop shadows, glossy 3D rendering, and text inside the icon.
prompt_blocks.purpose_wrapper: an app launcher tile expressing the visual theme of "{purpose}" — render this as a full-colour branded Home Screen app tile, NOT as a UI symbol, tab bar glyph, list-row icon, or feature glyph

forbidden_artifacts: Do not produce SF Symbols-style monochrome glyphs, tab bar icons, button icons, or list-row icons (except for `watch` and `notification` variants whose state requirements explicitly demand monochrome silhouettes). The output must read as a complete app launcher tile, not as a UI symbol or feature icon.
Do not draw multiple disconnected motifs; the icon is one unified iconic mark.
Do not include text, captions, watermarks, signatures, or UI chrome.
Do not draw scenery, photorealistic shading, soft drop shadows, heavy gradients, or glossy 3D effects.
Do not use the chroma-key colour or chroma-adjacent colours in the icon, outline, or accents.

watch: This variant is a watchOS launcher icon: render as a 1-bit monochrome silhouette on the chroma-key background. The full-colour-tile rule does NOT apply to this variant — silhouette is required.
Keep the silhouette simple and recognisable at watch-face scale.
notification: This variant is a notification icon: render as a single-tone monochrome silhouette on the chroma-key background. The full-colour-tile rule does NOT apply to this variant — silhouette is required.
light: This variant is the light-mode launcher tile: full colour, designed to sit on light system surfaces.
dark: This variant is the dark-mode launcher tile: full colour, designed to sit on dark system surfaces.
